question: In which year was the Veltrane Observatory founded?

docs.title: Veltrane Observatory history
docs.text: The Veltrane Observatory was founded in 1987 on the slopes of Mount Corrin. It houses a 2.4 metre reflecting telescope.

docs.title: Visiting the Veltrane Observatory
docs.text: The Veltrane Observatory runs public stargazing nights every Friday. Tickets are sold at the visitor centre in Halden.

question: Who founded the Kessridge Seed Bank?

docs.title: Kessridge Seed Bank origins
docs.text: The Kessridge Seed Bank was founded by botanist Imara Solberg to preserve alpine grain varieties.

docs.title: Kessridge Seed Bank facilities
docs.text: The Kessridge Seed Bank stores more than 40,000 samples in a vault cut into granite.

question: How many moons does the planet Orvex have?

docs.title: Orvex fact sheet
docs.text: The planet Orvex has 7 confirmed moons, the largest of which is Tamsin.

docs.title: Orvex orbit
docs.text: Orvex orbits its star once every 412 days.

question: What is the capital of Norvania?

docs.title: Norvania overview
docs.text: The capital of Norvania is Estholm, a port city on the Gray Sea.

docs.title: Norvania trade
docs.text: Norvania joined the Coastal Trade Union in 2004.

question: Which company manufactures the Halcyon X2 drone?

docs.title: Halcyon X2 product page
docs.text: The Halcyon X2 drone is manufactured by Pelloris Dynamics in its Linz plant.

docs.title: Halcyon X2 review
docs.text: The Halcyon X2 drone has a flight time of 38 minutes.

question: When did the Marrowfield Bridge open?

docs.title: Marrowfield Bridge history
docs.text: The Marrowfield Bridge opened to traffic in 1932 after four years of construction.

docs.title: Marrowfield Bridge engineering
docs.text: The Marrowfield Bridge spans 640 metres across the Ilse River.

question: Who composed the opera The Glass Orchard?

docs.title: The Glass Orchard
docs.text: The Glass Orchard is an opera composed by Lucan Ferreira and first staged in Lisbon.

docs.title: Premiere notes
docs.text: The Glass Orchard premiered at the Teatro Aurora with a cast of twelve.

question: How many employees does Brightmoor Analytics have?

docs.title: Brightmoor Analytics company profile
docs.text: Brightmoor Analytics has 1,250 employees across three offices.

docs.title: Brightmoor Analytics founding
docs.text: Brightmoor Analytics was spun out of a university lab in Tallinn.

question: What is the boiling point of the solvent Calderine?

docs.title: Calderine data sheet
docs.text: The boiling point of Calderine is 143 degrees Celsius at sea level.

docs.title: Calderine uses
docs.text: Calderine is a colourless solvent used in resin production.

question: Who is the current director of the Ashgrove Institute?

docs.title: Ashgrove Institute leadership
docs.text: Priya Nandakumar is the current director of the Ashgrove Institute, appointed after a global search.

docs.title: About the Ashgrove Institute
docs.text: The Ashgrove Institute studies coastal erosion and publishes an annual atlas.
